title: Named Recursive Factorial Baseline
description: Review the standard named recursive factorial function before eliminating def and function names in the Y combinator derivation.

steps.description: Define factorial_named(n), which returns 1 when n == 0 and n * factorial_named(n - 1) otherwise.
Notice that line 3 looks up factorial_named in the global environment to make the recursive call.

steps.question: What does [factorial_named(n) for n in range(8)] produce?

steps.description: Print the list of factorials for n in range(8).
Step into factorial_named(n) on line 3 to see the named self-call in action.
